Name: Crab Pots to Crab Nets (Fairy and Mundane)
Author: metricula
Description: Replaces the Crab Pots with Crab Nets, with either pink (Fairy) or mundane (red) bobbers. Includes sprites for empty, full, or baited crab nets as well as animation when you collect the fish from the net. The bobbers will bob just above and just below the waterline.

Manifest.Name: Fairy Crab Nets
Manifest.Description: Reskins the crab pots as crab nets with pink bobbers (fairy) or red bobbers (mundane).
